messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — PartnerSat (HW SI) started sending per-minute CDRs with intermittent heartbeat events. We’re seeing ~1-2% of minute batches arrive without a heartbeat field. Need to align on TTL/ACK and recon fallback asap.
Tom: ack, timeline? can we triage today?
Suhail: I'll pull logs. initial guess: their edge device retries but sometimes drops the heartbeat flag on lossy links. payload looks like: `{"minute":"2026-03-20T14:03Z","seqno":12345,"usage":42,"heartbeat":null}`
Maya: Oof. For billing we can’t accept null heartbeat as authoritative. options: 1) hold-window (5m) + accept late heartbeats, 2) accept but mark as provisional and reconcile, 3) reject and ask partner to replay.
Ana: Preference toward (2) provisional + automated reconciliation; less customer friction. But we need agreement on how provisional usage maps to entitlements (do we reserve credits?)
Tom: propose provisional -> reserve but don’t finalize on ledger. If replay arrives within 24h commit; else apply grace credit policy (small %).
Suhail: technically we can tag events with `provisional:true` and a `claim_deadline` TTL. ingestion pipeline support: add `claim_deadline_ts` and `orig_seqno` fields. example: ```json
{"minute":"...","seqno":12345,"provisional":true,"claim_deadline_ts":1719992345}
```
Maya: That works. For reconciliation job: batch job runs hourly to match provisional -> confirmed. If no match after 24h, create reversal/credit. Need playbook for edgecases (duplicate seqno from partner replays).
Ana: Can partnership team commit to replay semantics (idempotent seqno + monotonic seqno)? @partner-bot can you confirm?
partner-bot: PartnerSat integration status: replay semantics documented as idempotent by seqno, but edge firmware v1.2 had intermittent seqno resets. Ops is rolling v1.3 this week.
Tom: ok firmware roll helps but we must cover resets: add an `edge_instance_id` and accept resequencing if `seqno` drops — use windowed dedupe per `edge_instance_id`.
Suhail: Implementation notes for infra: 1) mark incoming without heartbeat as provisional 2) set claim_deadline = now + 24h 3) store orig_seqno + edge_instance_id 4) reconciliation daemon matches replays and flips state or issues credit 5) metric: provisional_rate and reconcile_success_rate.
Maya: Also need entitlement mapping: provisional usage should decrement a held entitlement bucket (soft-reserve) and finalization moves to billed bucket. Ops: ensure held reservations don’t block other usage (soft cap).
Ana: Action items: - @Suhail add ingestion support PR by EOD (create proto for provisional flag + claim_deadline) - @Tom draft partner playbook language for SLA + credit policy - @Maya update entitlements model doc with soft-reserve semantics - @PartnerSat (ops) confirm firmware rollout ETA and seqno guarantees
Tom: I'll ping legal for language around credits. 
Suhail: Will open ticket and drop sample payload + unit tests. putting faucet: `ingest-provisional` feature flag for 2w ramp.
Maya: +1 to feature flag. We'll also add dashboard card for provisional rate (alert if >0.5%).
Ana: Thanks team — can we sync standup 30m to finalize? :thumbsup:
Tom: 30m works.
partner-bot: Noted — PartnerSat ops ETA for v1.3 rollout: 2026-03-22T02:00Z (GMT).
